neighbours.label: The piece 'lam' of chlamydia and Chlamydomonas; other infections and algae stay quiet
fire: Clinics test for chlamydia free of charge.
The green alga Chlamydomonas swims with two flagella.
He tested positive for Chlamydia last year.
Rates of chlamydia rose among teenagers.
Both gonorrhea and chlamydia respond to antibiotics.
A vaccine against chlamydia is being studied.
